name: The drive aids config codec matches the firmware's ABS, traction and launch control layout
step: Check the drive aids config codec and Drive Aids page
rationale:
The Drive Aids pages (Tuning -> ABS / Traction / Launch) save by
writing back what they read. The command ids, the order of the nine ABS U8 fields, the traction control
fields after them (U8 tc_mode, U16 tc_ramp_time; 12 bytes) and the launch control fields after those
(U8 lc_mode, U8 lc_throttle, U16 lc_ramp_time; 16 bytes), and their ranges and
defaults are pinned here against the firmware handler (gripora-firmware msp.c,
MSP2_GRIPORA_DRIVE_AIDS_CONFIG 0x5F3F / MSP2_GRIPORA_SET_DRIVE_AIDS_CONFIG 0x5F40,
pg/drive_aids.h): the firmware refuses the whole write if any value is out of
range. A nine- or twelve-byte reply is older firmware without traction or launch control and is written
back with the same length; a longer reply must still decode the known sixteen and the write
must stay sixteen; a reply shorter than nine is refused. The harness also checks that
the ABS, Traction Control and Launch Control pages between them build every field, refuse saves while
armed, do not reboot and follow the current PID profile (the settings are stored per
profile), and that they sit in the Drive Aids group of the Tuning menu with icons that exist.
